writeup.headline: Small and wind-affected until Thursday, then a clean southeast swell makes Friday and Saturday the days to go, with Point Judith and Monahan's Dock the pick.

days.summary: Knee-high and choppy this afternoon: about 1.5 ft at 7 s with a 15 mph southwest wind blowing onshore at every spot. Not worth the drive.

Wind swings to the north-northeast overnight and cleans things up at dawn, but the swell is still small (about 1.6 ft at 8 s). Town Beach and Scarborough are fair for an early longboard session before the wind picks up past 12 mph.
Much the same: small southeast swell, light northerly wind at dawn turning cross-shore by mid-morning. Fair at dawn for Town Beach, Monahan's Dock and Scarborough; poor after that.
The new southeast swell starts to show in the afternoon (2.5 ft at 10 s). Morning is still small; Matunuck is fair at dawn on the offshore northwest wind, and the beaches improve late in the day.

The best day of the week. The swell peaks around 3.5 ft at 11 s from the southeast, well inside every spot's window, with a light west-northwest wind. Point Judith and Monahan's Dock are rated good all afternoon; Town Beach is good at dawn too.
Still good in the morning as the swell eases to about 3 ft at 10 s and the wind stays offshore. It turns south and onshore after lunch, so go early: Point Judith and Matunuck are the best bets.
Fading and blown out: under 2 ft with a 15–20 mph south wind. Poor everywhere.

caveats: Friday's swell size depends on a storm that is still a long way offshore, so expect the numbers to change in the next few updates.
Tide isn't part of the ratings yet, so check the tide chart for the spot you pick.
